contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ P[AX PVBLICA] ; D/ [FL IVL HELENAE AVG]

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena, AD 337-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads P[AX PVBLICA]. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch in right hand. Mint is Trier. Obverse legend reads [FL IVL HELENAE AVG]. Obverse shows a draped bust right. Weight is 1.65g, diameter is 14.8mm, thickness is 1.9mm. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(dot)TRP[...].
